name: python-cachecontrol
note: Updated to the upstream v0.15.0 release (sdist 0.15.0 corresponds to tag v0.15.0). Retain the Devario source choice: the PyPI sdist with a pkgver-templated URL and Arch epoch=1. The 0.15.0 sdist switched the build backend from flit to uv_build (requires uv_build>=0.9.6,<0.14.0), so makedepends uses python-uv-build from devario-development/uv instead of python-flit-core3. check() installs the wheel into a --system-site-packages venv because 0.15.0 resolves __version__ through importlib.metadata. CherryPy is a test fixture, not a runtime requirement.
